_comment: OPTIONAL VARIANT of vercel.json — not read by Vercel under this file name.
Use it if you want ONE public URL with no cross-origin calls at all: Vercel
serves the SPA and proxies /api to the Render web service, so the client can
keep its default relative base and you do NOT need VITE_API_BASE_URL.
How: copy this over frontend/vercel.json, replace RENDER_SERVICE_URL below
(the https://...onrender.com origin shown on the service's Settings page),
and deploy. Rewrites are evaluated in array order, so the /api rule must stay
above the SPA fallback. Verified against the API in this repo: /api is the only
prefix the SPA calls (frontend/src/lib/api.ts), FastAPI already allows
cross-origin preflights, and uploads go through /api/documents/upload, so
12 MB request bodies stay within Vercel's rewrite body limits for this app.
Trade-off worth knowing: Vercel's proxy adds a hop, and Render's Free plan
answers the first request after an idle period ~1 min later (Render shows its
own loading page while it spins up). With VITE_API_BASE_URL instead, the browser
sees that cold start directly and can retry per-request.
